title: I built a detective game where the AI game master knows who did it and can't tell you
author: StatusRow6416
selftext:
[Culprix](https://culprix.com) is a murder mystery you play by typing. Each case is written in advance, solution included. An LLM game master runs it, and you investigate however you like. When you're sure, you name who did it, why, and how, and you're scored against the case's answer.

The hard part is keeping a model that holds the answer from leaking it, inventing facts, or steering you. AI players test every case, and a judge model reads their transcripts. Opus 5.5 broke the rules about a quarter as often as Sonnet 5.

No hints and no suggested actions. Some cases are free each month, no card needed. If you get the GM to spill a solution, tell me how.
